parameters.note: Alder Creek (Nevada Co.), a Truckee-area tributary of Prosser Creek/Truckee River distinct from the Mendocino County 'Alder Creek' special-regulation water, is not named in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b) — the only 'Alder Creek' entry in either list is the Mendocino County water below Tramway Gulch. Alder Creek (Nevada Co.) therefore follows the general statewide stream regulation §5.85(a)(2): open all year, with a 5-trout harvest season from the last Saturday in April through Nov. 15 and a 0-trout, artificial-lures-with-barbless-hooks catch-and-release season from Nov. 16 through the Friday before the last Saturday in April.

end.verbatim: Friday preceding the last Saturday in April

candidates.summary: Open all year under the general statewide stream regulation: harvest season (last Saturday in April through Nov. 15, 5 trout) and a zero-trout catch-and-release season (Nov. 16 through the Friday before the last Saturday in April, artificial lures with barbless hooks only). Not listed as a special-regulation water (distinct from the Mendocino Co. 'Alder Creek').

parameters.counting_rule: General statewide trout limit for inland streams during the open harvest season (last Saturday in April through November 15): five trout daily, ten in possession, with no gear restrictions.

candidates.summary: 5 trout daily bag limit, 10 trout possession limit during the open harvest season (last Saturday in April through Nov. 15).
